thread:
Michaela S.: Keystone sent their RFI. They want a capability matrix, a POC playbook for a short Dedicated trial, clarity on burst pricing, and confirmation on KMS/HSM options. Can we assign owners?
Anya G.: I'll take the matrix + POC doc. I'll start from the Ember template and pare it down. Will attach: keystone_matrix_draft.csv and poc_playbook_template.md (links).
Samir R.: POC requirements look like: 2-week Dedicated window, baseline 8 GPUs, surge up to 24 GPUs for 1-2 hours/day, KV cache persistence across sessions, and ability to swap to a quantized build mid-run. We should be explicit about rollback.
Elaine (Security): From security side: they want KMS integration details and a note on HSM requirement if they insist on FIPS/HSM-backed keys. I can provide SOC2 report and pen-test exec summary. If HSM is required for Private deployment, legal + infra lead time applies.
Jules - Sales Ops: Pricing question: how do we model burst? Options: 1) temporary reserve (short-term addon billed pro-rata) or 2) burst credits consumed at higher unit price. Which is standard?
Samir R.: Ops prefers burst credits. Simpler operationally and avoids changing infra reservations. Propose: baseline reserved capacity + monthly burst credit pool, excess billed at 1.75x unit rate.
Michaela S.: Customer explicitly called out SLOs: "99th percentile latency for chat < 200ms; p50 < 120ms under expected mix." They also want automatic fallback to a cheaper model variant if latency breaches target.
Anya G.: I'll add a perf table to the matrix showing expected p50/p99 for float vs quantized models at 128/512 token contexts. Also include a short eval harness to validate quality delta pre/post quantization.
Samir R.: Ops config to include in playbook (suggested):
```
service: dedicated
baseline_replicas: 4
burst_pool_capacity: 16
burst_policy:
  max_multiplier: 3
  window_mins: 120
slo:
  p50_ms: 120
  p99_ms: 200
fallback:
  on_latency_exceed: route_to_cheaper_variant
  canary_check_seconds: 60
```
Anya G.: That looks good. I'll convert to a runnable snippet and add a step for running bench.sh to generate the perf table.
Elaine (Security): Note for the RFI response: provide the KMS integration doc and list supported key providers. If they require HSM, include projected uplift: ~+20% on infra cost and 6-8 week lead time for Private installs. Will confirm with legal on contractual wording.
Jules - Sales Ops: Draft pricing appendix idea: line item A: Reserved 8 GPUs (monthly) + line item B: 24 burst-credit-hours/month included; excess at 1.75x unit price. Also include an alternative: reserve 16 GPUs for shorter term (2-week commit) with lower burst rate.
Michaela S.: Need a clear rollback threshold for model quality: suggest auto-rollback if eval accuracy drop > 3% on their verification prompts OR if latency > 200ms for >5% of requests for 10 minutes. Ops to confirm feasibility.
Samir R.: Feasible. We'll implement an automated canary: deploy quantized to 10% traffic, run evals every 10 minutes, if quality/latency breach then immediate traffic shift back + page ops. Add manual runbook steps for investigation.
Anya G.: Deliverables I'll produce: keystone_matrix_v1.csv, keystone_poc_playbook_v1.md (includes ops snippet + bench commands), keystone_eval_prompts.zip (prompt list + scoring script). ETA: draft PDFs/links by EOD tomorrow.
Elaine (Security): I'll upload SOC2 summary, penetration test highlight, KMS integration guide, and a short note on HSM path + estimated timeline. ETA tomorrow afternoon.
infra-bot: Reminder: use secure file share links for large artifacts. Slack uploads over 10MB may fail; use internal file server with expiring links.
Jules - Sales Ops: I'll draft the pricing appendix and a sample contract clause for burst capacity and data residency. I'll loop in Legal for HSM pricing uplift language.
Michaela S.: Great. Plan: Anya owns matrix+POC, Samir owns ops config+rollback, Elaine owns security pack, Jules owns pricing appendix. 30-min review tomorrow 11:00 PT, then send consolidated RFI response. :thumbsup:
Samir R.: One last item: include a tiny perf chart in the matrix (p50/p99 per token length). I can run benchmarks tonight and drop numbers in a CSV.
Anya G.: Thanks all. I'll reconcile perf numbers into the matrix and mark any assumptions.
